_comment: Optional. Merge the mcpServers entry into your project's .mcp.json to give SciFi the Zotero MCP literature route (zotero-mcp by 54yyyu, MIT; install with: pip install zotero-mcp-server). ZOTERO_LOCAL=true reads your local Zotero database, so Zotero must be running on this machine. Without it SciFi uses Literature/library.json (Better BibTeX export) and Literature/fulltext/. Setup for both routes: docs/zotero-guide.md.
